validated_results.title: Garlic constituent diallyl trisulfide prevents development of poorly differentiated prostate cancer and pulmonary metastasis multiplicity in TRAMP mice.
validated_results.reason: Diallyl trisulfide was administered exclusively to TRAMP mice, a preclinical model with no human incidence data.
